description: A CAPABILITY with the Ed4 bit clear is ignored: the peer stays of unknown edition, gets EMPTY and no PADDING.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). At 1500, during a burst, conn 1 sends an S_UNIDATA_REQUEST (priority 0, SAP 5 at 0.0.1.3, DELIVERY MODE default, TTL 0 so TTD = 1500 + 1296000000 ms, U_PDU "hello", no confirmation): no SIS output (A-0095), dts.ttd starts (C-1050). At 2000 a PADDING D_PDU (type 14) from 0.0.1.3, unknown, to 0.0.1.2, address size 3, EOT 10 (end 7000), EOW 0xF00, CAPABILITY with Ed4 clear and Duplex clear: ignored (C-1261), so 0.0.1.3 stays of unknown edition. At 52000 the type 7 to 0.0.1.3 carries EOW 0, EMPTY (C-0419, C-1260), and the rest of the block is the modem's zero fill, no PADDING (C-1154). Burst end 3000: csma.vdcd_end 4000; at 7000 LBT rule 1 (K-0067, K-0068), seed 0 draws slot 15, CONT_WAIT 45000 (K-0080). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 256 bytes and 4800 ms a block; the 35-byte type 7 (C_PDU ID 0, offset 0, DATA C_PDU holding the DATA S_PDU SAP 5 to SAP 5 with its TTD, address size 3) needs one block, duration 5550, so EOT and reception window 10 (C-0104, C-0350, C-1043). The transmit queue empties, so dts.ttd is cancelled (C-1050).
